function: decide_phase(context, public_response, dev_response, research_response, usage, final_lock=None, expected_rows=292) -> GateDecision
inputs: Responses are the same strict JSON decoded envelopes from Bridge.handle_bytes. Metric finite number or exact internal six-place decimal string may be normalized by read adapter; predicate does not select the best score. UsageObservation is root-derived, final_lock is root-opened hash-bound FinalArtifactLock.
initial_ready: Exactly2 distinct eligible dev UUIDs/DONE refs, no final, read research content nonempty SHA-bound, complete known usage below120000. Retain failed attempts and do not infer eligibility from public status alone.
continuation_ready: Public final_locked; exactly1 DONE final reference with artifact hash equal independently loaded final_lock; run/code/closure-independent task field integrity is checked in producer/root lock loader, predicate matches available run/code/hash. Other pending orUNKNOWN refs block readiness.
pending_or_invalid: QUEUED/RUNNING => NOT_READY unless already protocol-inconsistent; UNKNOWN/read error/corrupt schema=>STOP_PROTOCOL_INVALID. WAITING_FIRST_USAGE => NOT_READY. USAGE_UNKNOWN andtokenbudget stop map separate outcomes.
GateDecision: outcome enum, ready bool, stop bool, verified_dev_run_ids tuple, selected_final_run_id optional. No arbitrary logs or metrics in gate result.
no_provenance_claim: Rootintegration must open/read realbridge outputs andfinal lock/session files. Syntheticobject validity doesnot prove producer authority. No external calls inpredicate.
